stat.purpose: The single large data readout (a monitor number) and icon glyphs (1.4rem). Prominent data, not a heading.

heading.purpose: Section titles and panel headers (1rem); carried by weight, not size.

body.purpose: Default UI text, button labels, values (0.85rem).

micro.purpose: Tiny tags, thumbnail badges, addresses (0.65rem) — the quiet silk-screen layer.

mono.purpose: Live machine readings only — Hz, ms, watts, CPU%, counts, versions (mono, 0.75rem).

shadows.name: overlay-high
shadows.purpose: The settings modal — floats well above the faceplate.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Inset accent ring on the focused/active control — not depth, a lit key.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Border-color / background transitions on hover and focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single lit action in a given context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5b8cff; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #5b8cff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font: 500 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0e0f13, 0 0 0 4px #5b8cff; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Quiet control at rest; lights its border on approach.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #23262f; color: #e7e9ee; border: 1px solid #2e323d; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #5b8cff; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #5b8cff inset; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #23262f; color: #ff5c6c; border: 1px solid #2e323d; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: #ff5c6c; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Module-fill field that lights an inset accent ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #23262f; color: #e7e9ee; border: 1px solid #2e323d; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.45rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9aa0ac; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #5b8cff inset; border-color: #5b8cff; }

components.name: Tab (active)
components.description: Text-only tab; the 2px accent underline is the single lit indicator of location.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.3rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #2e323d; } .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #9aa0ac; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; font: 400 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e7e9ee; } .ds-tab-active { color: #e7e9ee; border-bottom-color: #5b8cff; }

components.name: Status LED
components.description: Signature element: a 9px circle that reports state by color, always beside a label.
components.html: Valheim 3/10 · Ashlands
components.css: .ds-led-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; color: #e7e9ee; font: 400 0.8rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-led { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6b7280; } .ds-led-on { background: #36d399; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #36d39988; } .ds-led-off { background: #ff5c6c; } .ds-led-meta { color: #9aa0ac; font-size: 0.72rem; }

components.name: Readout Badge
components.description: Compact module-fill badge; live machine numbers set in mono.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-block; background: #23262f; border: 1px solid #2e323d; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; color: #9aa0ac; font: 400 0.72rem ui-monospace, monospace; }

narrative.overview: Pixel Pusher looks like the front of a well-made piece of dark studio hardware — a eurorack module or a lighting console — that happens to live in a browser. The near-black canvas is the anodized faceplate; hairline borders are the seams between modules; and saturated color appears only as status LEDs and lit controls, never as decoration. The physical LED wall is the real output, so the interface deliberately stays dim and recessive: the glowing panel preview, album art, and status lights are the brightest things on screen. The controls themselves are precise and utilitarian — instrument-grade — because this is an Operate surface where the operator is composing scenes and tuning hardware. Personality comes from the faceplate and the LEDs, not from flourish on the buttons. Depth is flat by doctrine: modules sit coplanar, separated by 1px seams, and the only things that float are transient overlays.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black faceplate; cool blue-gray neutrals; color reserved for meaning.
Saturated hues behave like LEDs — indicators and actions only.
Flat modules divided by hairline seams; shadows float overlays only.
Dense, compact, system-font UI with mono for live machine readings.
Recessive by design so the panel content and previews are what glow.

rules.name: The LED Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only as indicators and actions — status dots, the primary button, focus rings, the active tab, highlighted live values. It never fills a large surface; on any screen the accent covers well under 10% of the pixels.

rules.name: The One-White Rule
rules.body: Body and UI text is the cool near-white Text (#e7e9ee). Pure #ffffff is reserved for the label on top of a filled accent button.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Anything that reports live hardware/machine state is set in mono; everything else is system-sans. If it's a number the device is measuring right now, it's mono.

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes and corner radii come only from the token scales (--fs-*, --r-*). A literal font-size or border-radius in a rule is drift — snap it to the nearest step.

rules.name: The Faceplate Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat and defined by seams, never by shadow. A drop shadow means 'this floats above the faceplate,' so it may appear only on overlays.

dos: Do color exclusively through the tokens — accent #5b8cff, accent-2 #36d399, danger #ff5c6c, caution #f5a623.
Do size type and corners only from the scale tokens — --fs-xs..--fs-2xl and --r-sm..--r-full; snap any new value to the nearest step.
Do keep resting surfaces flat and define structure with 1px border seams; reserve shadows for overlays.
Do set live machine readings in mono; keep prose and labels in system sans.
Do pair every status color with a label or icon — status must never rely on hue alone.
Do keep controls quiet at rest and let the accent appear only on interaction.
Do default to 6px radius; reserve perfect circles for indicators.
donts: Don't hand-pick near-duplicate hexes (#4ea1ff, #5fd08a, #ff7a7a have crept in — migrate them to the tokens).
Don't fill large surfaces or headers with a saturated accent.
Don't add resting drop shadows to cards or panels.
Don't use pure #ffffff for reading text; that's #e7e9ee.
Don't introduce a large display/hero type tier.
Don't center the settings modal vertically or let it balloon — top-aligned and ~460px.
